vectors.name: empty-previous
vectors.comment: first frame: no anchors exist, whole frame is one literal

vectors.name: identical-empty
vectors.comment: empty to empty still emits a single empty-text literal segment

vectors.name: identical-nonempty
vectors.comment: unchanged frame collapses to one copy segment; literalBytes=0 but the 64-byte segment overhead can still fail the efficient gate on small frames

vectors.name: single-line-pane
vectors.comment: one partial line, no newline; below the 3-line anchor floor so it is all literal

vectors.name: scrollback-roll
vectors.comment: top line scrolls off, bottom line arrives: copy shifts by one line

vectors.name: middle-rewrite-isolated
vectors.comment: SplitAfter leaves a trailing "" element after the final newline, so the tail anchors as {four,five,""}; without that phantom line this edit would be one literal

vectors.name: middle-rewrite-anchored
vectors.comment: three unchanged lines on each side let the edit sit in a literal between two copy segments
